newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank leads modest Estonia share gains.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank leads modest Estonia share gains.

text.p: Market blue chip Hansapank led modest gains on the Estonian stock market on Friday amid healthy bourse volumes, dealers said.
The stock exchange index gained 1.12 percent to close at 188.95 on turnover of 27.0 million kroons on the official list.

Hansapank was market leader and well traded on turnover of 16.2 million kroons to gain 3.25 kroons to end at 185.25 kroons. Dealers said Hansapank was benefiting from optimism after it released its 1996 consolidated results on Monday.
"The results still affect the price with strong buying interest from both locals and foreigners," one trader said.
Tallinna Pank also firmed by 0.90 kroons to close on 59.50 kroons with a trade of 5.8 million kroons.
Savings Bank was 1.55 kroons higher to finish on 90.25 kroons with a trade of 2.5 million kroons.
Forekspank was stable at 144.50 after registering a trade of 1.5 million kroons.
On the over-the-counter market, trade was stronger at 14.4 million kroons of shares.
The EMV construction company was most traded to turn over 8.5 million kroons of shares to close 25 kroons lower on 1,275 kroons.
"There was a block deal of about 5000 shares which explained the volume, but no other new news," a dealer said.
Rakvere meat plant firmed by 0.20 kroons to finish on 13.00 kroons after turning over three million kroons of shares.
Norma plastic maker saw a trade of two million kroons of shares to end 0.95 kroons lower at 57.30 kroons.
